title.zh: 应力–应变曲线 · 屈服、韧性与断裂
title.en: Stress–strain curves · yield, toughness and fracture

description.zh: 把材料拉长时，应力（单位面积上的力）对应变（相对伸长）的曲线先是一段直线（弹性，松手能回去），过了屈服点开始永久变形，最后颈缩断裂；曲线下的面积是断裂前吸收的能量，叫韧性。
description.en: As a material is stretched, its curve of stress (force per area) against strain (relative stretch) starts as a straight line (elastic — it springs back), turns into permanent deformation past the yield point, and ends in necking and fracture; the area under the curve is the energy absorbed before breaking, called toughness.

nodes.formula: σ = F/A, ε = ΔL/L₀, σ = Eε

aliases.zh: 为什么玻璃会碎而钢会弯
aliases.en: why does glass shatter while steel bends

label.en: Young’s modulus is the initial slope

reason.zh: 弹性段应力与应变成正比，σ = Eε，杨氏模量 E 就是这段直线的斜率：斜率越大，材料越难拉长。
reason.en: In the elastic stretch stress is proportional to strain, σ = Eε, and Young’s modulus E is the slope of that line: the steeper it is, the harder the material is to stretch.

label.en: Toughness is the area under the curve

reason.zh: 每伸长一点吸收的能量密度是 σ·dε，从 0 积到断裂应变就是韧性——强度高却拉不长的材料，面积未必大。
reason.en: Each small stretch absorbs energy density σ·dε, and integrating from zero to the fracture strain gives toughness — a strong material that barely stretches need not enclose a large area.

reason.zh: 应力和压强都是力除以面积、单位都是帕斯卡；压强常指流体或接触面上的推压，应力描述材料内部每个截面承受的拉或压。
reason.en: Stress and pressure are both force divided by area, measured in pascals; pressure usually describes a push from a fluid or a contact, while stress describes the pull or push carried across each cross-section inside a material.
